name: C and O Farms
description: A small apple orchard in 480 Wilkies Grove Church Road, NC, C and O Farms grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The orchard is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
